plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: Anthropology (BA). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] Must make a grade of C or better.
[grid1 fn2] Complete 14 hours of a foreign language through the intermediate level. If you choose to enroll in a language you have studied previously without receiving college credit, you must first take a placement test. See academic advisor.
[grid1 fn3] No anthropology course will satisfy this requirement.
[grid1 fn4] Select from ANTH 302 , ANTH 308 , ANTH 313 , ANTH 316 , ANTH 317/RELS 317 , ANTH 318 , ANTH 323 , ANTH 330 , ANTH 345 , ANTH 350 , ANTH 351 , ANTH 353/CLAS 353 , ANTH 354/CLAS 354 , ANTH 360 , ANTH 401 , ANTH 402 , ANTH 408 , ANTH 414 , ANTH 417/CLAS 417 , ANTH 418 , ANTH 419 , ANTH 420 , ANTH 421/MUST 421 , ANTH 436/RELS 436 , ANTH 438/RELS 438 , ANTH 444/CLAS 444 , ANTH 447 , ANTH 453 , ANTH 461 , ANTH 464 , ANTH 462 , ANTH 472 , ANTH 485 , ANTH 489 .
[grid1 fn5] Required prerequisite for STAT 302 or STAT 303 .
